config.grain_rationale: One row per ACNC-registered charity; the record describes the registered legal entity plus the single contact address it lodged with the ACNC. ABN is not guaranteed unique (duplicates/blanks occur), so record identity is content-derived.

record_id.rationale: ABN is blank in ~0.6% of rows and repeats for some entities, so it is not a reliable unique key; hash the full record content instead.

fields.rationale: Column explicitly named Charity_Legal_Name on the ACNC register = registered legal name.
Other names the charity is known by (trading/display names), explicitly separate from the legal name column.
ABN column; checksum-validated by the abn transform.
Charity_Website mixes bare domains, http(s) URLs and free text; first URL/domain token extracted and hard-validated so prose blobs drop.
ACNC registration date; DD/MM/YYYY confirmed by day>12 values. Does not fall back to Date_Organisation_Established.

Address lines combined into ONE contact address. Address_Type is uniformly 'Business' and values include PO boxes ('Po Box 576') and venue names ('Egan Park'), so this is a postal/contact address, NOT confirmed premises; canonical address.full is only loosely accurate here. Cosmetic fix: the composite is whitespace-collapsed then trimmed as a whole, removing the raw trailing space in State that previously produced ' , ', so it renders 'Gawler, SA, 5118' cleanly. Venue/PO-box fragments retained, since dropping them would destroy the only address evidence.
Town/city (suburb) field; trailing spaces present in discovery are trimmed. Case preserved as sourced.
Australian state abbreviations; trimmed so 'SA ' normalises; unknown maps to OTHER.
4-digit AU postcodes; strict 4-digit token extraction drops 5-digit and town-name values.

Critic fix. The value is uppercased then matched against an ANCHORED allowlist of Australian spellings only; anything else (SINGAPORE, ARUBA, and the data-entry error AUSTRIA on an Altona North VIC 3025 address) fails the match and yields null BEFORE map_enum runs, so nothing is emitted and no ENUM_UNMAPPED error is raised. Digit-bearing junk ('WA 6105') also fails the anchored pattern. Net effect: 'AU' for genuine Australian spellings, silence otherwise - never an invented or foreign country asserted as fact, and never a free-text passthrough.

config.notes: Revisions this round, addressing the critic's two flagged targets only. (1) address.country (was 'wrong'): the previous passthrough emitted 'AUSTRIA' verbatim on a record whose address is Altona North VIC 3025. Now the uppercased value must match an anchored allowlist of Australian spellings; everything else yields null before map_enum, so no observation is emitted and no ENUM_UNMAPPED error is raised (discovery: 425/426 emitted, error_rate 0.0, only 'Singapore' dropped). AU is never invented and no foreign country is asserted as fact. (2) address.full (was 'doubtful'): the composite is now collapse_whitespace'd then trimmed as a whole, removing the raw trailing space in State that produced the ' , ' artefact -> 'Gawler, SA, 5118'. Venue names and PO boxes are retained and the postal-vs-premises caveat stays in the rationale and in Address_Type's unmapped note; confidence remains 0.55 because that ambiguity is unresolvable from this source. Deliberately unchanged: ABN stays content_hash identity (ABN is non-unique/blank); entity_type/status/acn/industry_code stay unmapped (no source column; name morphology would be guessing); Charity_Size and Date_Organisation_Established stay unmapped with reasons; purpose/beneficiary flags and Operating_Countries stay unmapped.
